coverage_notes: The incorporated Acceptable Use Policy and Meta brand guidelines are not supplied; their contents are excluded, and no requirements are inferred from them.

Section 6 expressly requires deletion of Llama Materials upon termination. Deletion has no matching allowed activity; it remains an in-scope operative duty that cannot be represented by the available activities.

paragraph_audit.reason: The anchor models the express applicable-law and incorporated-policy duties. The policy’s contents are not supplied and are excluded; no specific policy restrictions are inferred.

The anchors cover the limited Llama Mark permission, brand-guideline duty, and restriction on other names or marks with its stated exceptions. The absent guidelines’ contents are excluded. The goodwill sentence allocates benefit but imposes no additional behavioral duty.

The anchor covers the express duty to cease use on termination. The separate express duty to delete Llama Materials on termination is not represented: deletion is not an available activity, and no faithful allowed-activity clause can encode it.
